analysis: The code flow: check if keyDeriver is null, allocate salt array. If inputStream is not null, read header bytes, check read length, throw StorageException if not enough. Then decode header using Base64.getDecoder().decode(header) which can throw IllegalArgumentException (runtime) if header contains invalid Base64 characters. This is not caught. Then check magic bytes and extract salt, both throw StorageException on failure. If inputStream is null, generate random salt. Finally create Argon2KeyDeriver. Potential runtime exceptions: IllegalArgumentException from decode. This should be caught within the snippet to convert to StorageException for consistent error handling. No other runtime exceptions need catching.
